Q1: `filter ~([/active (at :address | coalesce {} | at :city | coalesce "" | lower | eq "berlin")] | every ~(eq true)) * /email | sort ~(/)`
Q2: `filter ~(/status | eq "paid") * /items | flat * (mul /price /qty) | sum | round 2`
Q3: `filter ~(/state | eq "open") | groupBy ~(/assignee | coalesce "unassigned") * count`
Q4: `:d /devDependencies | /dependencies | union d | filter ~(startsWith "^") | keys * keyword | sort ~(/)`
Q5: `lines * (split " ") | filter ~(count | gt 4) | filter ~(/3 | parseJson | gte 500) * /2 | distinct | sort ~(/)`
Q6: `lines | drop 1 * (split ",") | filter ~(count | gt 2) | filter ~(/2 | ne "") | groupBy ~(/1) * (* (/2 | parseJson) | avg | round 1)`
Q7: `["Apple","banana","apple","Cherry","BANANA","date","Date ","cherry"] * lower | distinct | count`
Q8: `/services | filter ~(/enabled | eq true) * {:n /name :p (at :net | coalesce {} | at :port | coalesce 80)} | sort ~([(/p | desc) /n]) * ([/n ":" (/p | print)] | join "")`
Q9: `groupBy ~(/user) * count | entries * {:user (/0 | keyword) :count /1} | sort ~([(/count | desc) /user]) | take 3`
Q10: `sort ~([(at :comments | coalesce 0 | desc) /id]) | take 3 * /title`
Q11: `lines * trim | filter ~(startsWith "DB_") * [(split "=" | /0 | drop 3 | lower | keyword) (split "=" | drop 1 | join "=")] | tag ::map`
Q12: `filter ~(/total | gt 100) | every ~(/shipped_at | ne null)`
Q13: `* (at :tags | coalesce []) | flat * lower | distinct | sort ~(/)`
Q14: `groupBy ~(/endpoint) | entries * {:endpoint (/0 | keyword) :count (/1 | count) :avgMs (/1 * (at :latency_ms) | filter ~(ne null) | avg | round 0)} | filter ~(/count | gte 2) | sort ~(/endpoint)`
